    The depth function on periodic components #

    For the proof of Lemma 4.2 (lem:mesh-walk-free, scalar-normalization.tex): "A periodic component containing arrows gives a mapping torus, which retracts onto its core circle." By Proposition 4.1 a periodic component is covered by ℤΔ, and the deck transformations have the form (v, t) ↦ (ρ v, t + c₀) for a tree automorphism ρ (StarDeck.deck_height_form). "The automorphism ρ fixes a vertex or an edge midpoint of Δ" (lines 82–85): we use the centre of the path for type A, and the trivalent vertex for types D and E. The (doubled) distance to this centre is invariant under every deck transformation, so it descends to the component; each vertex has at most one neighbour at depth at most its own. This depth function drives the contraction onto the core circle in MeshComplex.lean.
